description: Android activity class 'PlayerActivity' that plays a workout video, displays overlay with title, elapsed time, and estimated calories, using ExoPlayer.

classes.name: PlayerActivity
classes.description: An Android activity that plays a workout video and displays overlay information such as title, elapsed time, and calories.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes the activity, sets layout, retrieves workout data, and sets up UI components.

methods.name: initPlayer
methods.description: Initializes and starts the ExoPlayer with the workout video.

methods.name: updateOverlay
methods.description: Updates the overlay with current playback position and estimated calories.

methods.name: onStart
methods.description: Starts the player when activity becomes visible.

methods.name: onStop
methods.description: Releases the player and stops updates when activity is no longer visible.
